# Superset contract evidence

Two authoritative sets, both generated by the pinned local Superset instance
and both holding unmodified raw REST bodies and official export ZIPs:

- `6.1.0/revenue/` -- the canonical question, its three datasets, and one
  controlled metric-expression drift;
- `6.1.0/usage/` -- charts and a dashboard seeded onto those same datasets, so
  chart --queries--> dataset and dashboard --contains--> chart are real
  evidence. Additive: it creates no dataset, so the revenue captures' pinned
  hashes are unaffected by regenerating it.

Parser unit tests may create small synthetic ZIPs, but they do not establish
upstream compatibility. Add another version only after its own pinned
real-source contract suite passes.
